At The Vivaha Stories, we turn our lens towards those moments. From wedding days to expressive portraits, every frame begins with you.

03 / The person behind the perspective

Engineer by training.
Storyteller by heart.

I’m Manoj Gangula, a photographer based in Hyderabad and the founder of The Vivaha Stories.

After two years as a CAE engineer, I followed the pull towards photography. Today, my work moves between weddings, fashion and portraits — with people at the centre of it all.

How do we enquire about a shoot?+

Share your preferred date, location and a little about the occasion through our enquiry form. You can send your details by email or WhatsApp, and discuss availability directly with Manoj.

Can we enquire about portraits or fashion work?+

Yes. Manoj’s portfolio includes fashion, portraits and wedding photography. Select your shoot type in the enquiry form and tell us what you have in mind.

Where are you based?+

The Vivaha Stories is based in Hyderabad, India. Include your shoot location in your enquiry to discuss the details.
